test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is correct with regard to the reflection of light by a spherical mirror?

(a) A convex mirror converges the light rays incident parallel to its principal axis.

(b) A concave mirror converges the light rays incident parallel to its principal axis.

(c) Convex mirror can form both, real and virtual images.

(d) Concave mirror can form both, real and virtual images.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only (b) and (d)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The focus of the convex mirror is behind the mirror.
 
• When the object is between infinity and the pole of the mirror, then the image formed is between the focus and pole of the mirror and behind the mirror.

 
• The image so formed by convex mirror is virtual and erect.
 
• Convex mirror always forms an image smaller than the object.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66be51a838c9f75f947f1e01f014a09dc300c1e52b3f1df15757fd294b36be14.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Spherical mirror: A mirror which has a shape which is cut from a spherical surface is called a spherical mirror.
 
• Convex mirror: When the reflecting surface of the mirror bulges towards the light source is called a convex mirror.
 
• Concave mirror: When the reflection surface is inward surface is called a concave mirror.
 
• Due to its rear wide view, the convex mirror is used in vehicles to see behind objects.
